title: Application Backup Restic Entity
description: Restic-specific configuration. Extends Application/Backup with restic-specific settings.

repository.description: Repository URL (local path, s3:, sftp:, rest:, etc.).

password_secret.description: Doorman secret reference for the repository password.

keep_last.description: Number of last snapshots to keep.

keep_daily.description: Number of daily snapshots to keep.

keep_weekly.description: Number of weekly snapshots to keep.

keep_monthly.description: Number of monthly snapshots to keep.

keep_yearly.description: Number of yearly snapshots to keep.

check_interval.description: How often to verify repository integrity (e.g., 7d, 30d).
